"""The ``app:send-report`` console command."""

from __future__ import annotations

from http import HTTPMethod, HTTPStatus
from typing import final

from xtr_console import ConsoleStyle, ExitCode, as_command, escape

__all__ = ["SendReportCommand"]


@final
@as_command("app:send-report", description="Describe what app:send-report does.")
class SendReportCommand:
    """Runs ``app:send-report``; describe what it is for here."""

    async def __call__(  # noqa: PLR0913 — one parameter per argument and option.
        self,
        io: ConsoleStyle,
        recipient: str,
        method: HTTPMethod,
        cc: list[str] | None = None,
        *,
        dry_run: bool = False,
        limit: int | None = None,
        status: HTTPStatus | None = None,
    ) -> int:
        """Run ``app:send-report``.

        Args:
            io: Where the command writes.
            recipient: Recipient.
            method: Method.
            cc: Cc.
            dry_run: Dry run.
            limit: Limit.
            status: Status.

        """
        io.text(escape(f"{recipient=}"))
        io.text(escape(f"{method=}"))
        io.text(escape(f"{cc=}"))
        io.text(escape(f"{dry_run=}"))
        io.text(escape(f"{limit=}"))
        io.text(escape(f"{status=}"))
        io.success("app:send-report ran.")
        return ExitCode.SUCCESS
